t: Greetings! How may I help you?

h: Gain access to Al Rihat Ruins portal

r154723.s: Chief Witchdoctor of the Old Tribe

t: A very strange hut... It looks like a normal house, but something is wrong about it.
Indistinct noises come from the inside - groans and mumbling. Wait... What is it?

Aho!

What are you looking for in this frozen land?
Nature is not a temple, but a workshop...

The analysis allows us to understand the following: the Spark is a multi-component entity contained in the concept of "soul". The Spark contains a certain "primordial flame" which makes it the basis of life. The flame is surrounded by a multitude of things that include the Threads of Fate. Invisible and ethereal, they extend from each Spark out into space. Mine are torn. Or rather, cut.

Now I remember: it was like a dream, a shining figure holding scissors in their hands. They... cut the Threads. Changed not only the future, but also the past. They... must be stopped!

It's simple - you kill local creatures, bandits and other vermin, and I'll show you how to get the necessary components for potions. I think additional properties will be useful to you on your journey through Jigran. You will conduct the tests at your own risk, I can't guarantee anything.
h: Well, tell me what you can do.

t:
Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Hhirkalla released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now.
Alice, or Klavdia as you call her, has always manipulated those around her, using them for her own purposes. Don't forget that.
I'm still busy with my experiments, working to improve zombies for the Necro-Incubator...

Fate? A very strange matter... But I don't think what happened affected me in any way. I'm still busy with my experiments, working to improve zombies for the Necro-Incubator... What changed?

Now we need to focus on research and experiments! Jigran is a unique place where many different forces collided - both divine and primal, one might even say primordial!

r526753.s: Brotherhood of the Last Shelter Guard

t: Captain Ignat Smolov! I see familiar faces! Well, we once fought gloriously, but now... now I wouldn't dare show myself before the eyes of Mistress Catherina. For now, I've found a job here, on Jigran... Maybe in time I'll get a place in the navy!
I don't like this expedition. I don't like anything at all!

Wind in the sails! Wind in the sails! Wherever we want to go, we'll go. That's what a ship is, you know. It's not just a keel and a hull and a deck and sails, that's what a ship needs but what a ship is... freedom!

Wind in the sails! Wind in the sails! Wherever we want to go, we'll go. That's what a ship is, you know. It's not just a keel and a hull and a deck and sails, that's what a ship needs but what a ship is... freedom!

Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!
Yes! I mean, no! I mean, affirmative!

Landlubbers! How dare you set your foot on board of my darling Eclipse! I'm going to hang you all on the main royal yard and let my crew laugh at your squirms!

Do you think you are heroes? You sucked in some power and you're on it together with the heretics, so now you're obviously thinking you're capable of defeating our Queen's army? Har! She's foreseen this!

You know what technology is? It is an order. An absolute, total order. No mistakes made or forgiven. I will teach you this lesson...
What is it that you need?

quests: The Plague of the Wandering Island

t: I am an authorized representative of the Empire. The Imperial mission is ready to provide your people with any possible assistance.

Akyl? I've heard the name before. He was the captain of the ship that brought us to Howlen through the Astral anomalies that for some reason storm around your allod... I've never talked to him, and he spent most of the time in his cabin.

Hm... Where have you heard these names?

Alright, don't say if you don't want to. I realize you don't trust us. To prove our good intentions, I will tell you everything I know.

Tep is a summoner from the Zem people who tried to reach immortality. He drained vital energy from Sparks, which you call tya, and thus prolonged his life.

In the end he was either killed or imprisoned, and his people died. Though they resurrected later... Now Zem call themselves the Arisen, and a certain group of radical religious bigots still worship Tep.

This is all I know. The history of the Arisen has never really interested me.

But I know nothing about the Master. I've never heard the name before. And neither has the Council, which says something.
h: Ask about Tep and the Master

t:
It's a large allod, discovered in the year 911 and located between the Empire and Kania. It is an ancient land that still remembers the dawn of the June civilization and the demise of the Zem. The Holy Land is also where you'll find a large temple built by Tep. Nowadays the pyramid is referred to as Tensess Temple. And for good reason, for it is in this very pyramid where the soul of the Great Mage resides. It is the cradle of Tensess' Gift, which you also call the Gift of Light.

Whoever takes possession of it shall gain control of the world's Holy magic. If we are successful, the League's priests and paladins will be stripped of their abilities, and none of their soldiers will ever be able to use Tensess' Gift to be reborn after death.

How do you know about the Holy Land? You never leave Howlem!
What to do next? Fire back! And should anyone break in, shred them to pieces right away - if they reach the reactor, even Zems won't put our bodies back together!

Victory? Don't you see that Octhulhu ahead of us?!

Our shields are drained; we can't face an Octulhu. We've got to hide in the Anomaly and pray it won't follow us there. Hold on tight!
Only guild members with the Officer title or higher can do this!

Look at it. Isn't it marvelous? But everything that moves needs fuel or food.

Sparks are a great resource for sustaining all kinds of life, be it a creature or machine. I have a couple of tasks for you. If you handle them, we can make our Keeper stronger.
Welcome, warriors! Where are you coming from? There are bandits in our forests, would you like to take a walk and stretch your legs a little?
I'll be with you in a wink of an eye! I'll just have to finish my beer, polish my cudgel, brush my beard, feed my horse, pray to Tensess, and I'm good to go!
h: Accept the fighter to the party

t:
Do you need coins?
Remember that exchange rates may vary depending on demand and supply.

You wish to purchase crystals? Or perhaps you have too many and wish to exchange them for some gold? I can help you with that!
Exchange rate is calculated based on the amount of Crystals I currently have. Everything is fare and square - as soon as the rate changes, I'll let you know.
The more Crystals people buy, the higher their price is. And vice versa.
First, choose if you are selling or buying. Enter the required amount, and I will tell you the price in gold. If it's fine with you, confirm the deal. I will double-check everything, and we'll seal the deal!
If the exchange rate changes while we are bargaining, I will freeze the deal and tell you the new rate. You will be able to decide if the new rate suits you or not.
Simple, fast and convenient!
Currency Exchange is unavailable at this time.Smugglers have it hard!

You just need to survive. Someone has to tell the world about the Architects. So.. Here, take it. This is my Adventurer's Stone. You can use to send the seeress to Nezebgrad. I think her words will sound convincing enough for Rysina. And you speak with Aidenus.

Now go. Your lives are so much more important than mine right now!
Go, before it's too late! I will hold them back. I would rather die than let the Architects pass!

Oh... Did you see that? Just one shot, and the ship turned to dust together with everyone who was onboard!

Damned bastards! Now we have no way out...
Who says I have to run around like a clockwork toy? You must think things through before doing anything, so why waste energy?

So I've found my destiny. Who says I have to run around like a clockwork toy? You must think things through before doing anything, so why waste energy? I'm glad I've overcome... what's that elven word? Procrastination, right! So I can continue to improve my village Oblomovka. There is so much to do there, since all peasants started resurrecting... I have already bought rare seeds, and cattle, and all sorts of mechanical tools straight from Xadagan... Soon we'll be the most advanced village in Sarnaut.
We are about to start a procedure of exchanging prisoners. Have you been sent here to help?

Are you ready to escort the elemental? If you want help from your comrades, have each of them talk to me first. Be sure that everyone understands the combat orders. Only then should you report that you are ready.
It’s not lunch time yet. If you’re here only for that, come back later.
h: I was told to feed the specimens

t: That one’s only next week. You must have got your schedule wrong.
You are going to be present? Really? Alright, go.
Stop, comrade! This is the experimental specimen department. What is the purpose of your visit?
You can get an answer, but in this world, knowledge has shape. Will you sacrifice the integrity of your soul for this?
The guardian of the Show Stele is silent.

Then listen... It's a very old story. They imprisoned me.

One who sought power searched for its source. The Great War he unleashed gave him countless allies who also dreamed of becoming powerful. But he had no intention to share, plotting a betrayal from the very beginning. They decimated entire worlds, seeking that power.

I was the only one who openly opposed them. I couldn't let him get to Her, and I needed time so She could escape. In the last battle of that war, my allies and I stood guard over one of the worlds.

I thought I was destined to die there, like the One who spent eternity with Her, but our Enemy was clever! He tricked and captured me, believing that I would share my power with him. He was wasting his time... My resolve was strong... Even though I craved freedom.
Hey, boss! Do you want me to kick out these sluggish idlers, so that you can replace them with some decent extra-angry fighters? No problem, will be done!

Hey, boss! Do you want me to kick out these sluggish idlers, so that you can replace them with some decent extra-angry fighters? No problem, will be done!

After I kick them, here’s what we will have:

Leader: 1;

Private: 0-2.

Do you want me to tease these piddlers to make them thirsty for the blood of your enemies? Huh, no sweat! Let me just smack that brat with a foul cloth, and he's ready to go! You give me the money first, like, {cost} gold, deal?
h: Increase Strength of all Defenders in the room to level {nextLevel} for {cost} gold

t: What? You’re leaving?! Ugh, alone again... You... I mean... you can drop by... if you like.
Oh, help me! The ghosts have drained all my strength! Perhaps you have {price} measures of Spark energy on you?
No, I can't do that yet...
Ugh, they're so slimy... Almost like my sister.
Well, if the Hero of Sarnaut could scare away these creepy reptiles and show me that I had nothing to fear... Do what you can, it will help anyway. Just don't rush...
h: And how can we rid you of your fear?

t: Yes, but first... I wanted to ask you.

This is not the first time you come when I need help. Of course, I try to repay you in kind, but... I need to know.

How much do I mean to you? Am I just a random acquaintance with useful skills? Or one of the hundreds of people rescued by the Hero of Sarnaut?
Greetings! You are finally here, on the Twilight Isle...

We naively assumed that everything would end on Yazes, but no: victory over demons is still far away.

So our Order will be needed for a while. We need a place to hide, since neither the Church nor anyone else will look kindly on us.

In my research on this allod, I have learned of a... place that could serve our purposes. Cultists consider it sacred, so they are afraid to go there. It is believed that it was there that the Master blessed the demons and ordered them to destroy Sarnaut. But now it's empty...

You can find it on some remote allod. However, there is a fast way to get there.

If you're willing to help me, I'll tell you about it.
h: What did you want to tell me?

t: Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Oh, hey! Hunting for treasure? I don't think there's enough for everyone.

It's my special field brew. I made it of local snakes' venom, spider poison, bats... What's wrong? I mean, it's really refreshing, although a little lethal... The Light hasn't gone anywhere the last time I checked. On the plus side, it turns you into a ferocious warrior! Makes you unstoppable!

h: It's too easy to die without it. I'll pass.

t: Here's to you and to your funeral!
h: As they say, live fast and die young! Hand over your potion.

t: Oh, wow! There's a whole library!
We dispelled the barrier, but it cost us all our crystals! We placed them in the barrier, it vanished, and the crystals turned to dust.
Bloody orcs are out hunting. Ore is mined in the mountains, to the east from here, and these animals want to get their hands on some good iron...

...The Architect's voice sounds like an echo. It seems like it is surrounding you, and thousands of resounding and vibrating voices tell you:

"We wish to build the Path. The Path of Order, the path of Harmony which goes through time and space. You do not understand it. you are poisoned with Chaos. You do not see the essence of things. You are shattered. Secluded. Broken.

Stop destroying the whole, and accept the Ascension. Then you will behold the purpose of the whole creation: the pursuit of harmony, the reduction of entropy, and achieving the Absolute! Do not resist what is predestined!"
h: Find out what the Architect wants

t: I am the Architect. I am the Order. Why do you resist the Ascension? Why don't you want to be part of the whole?
What is predestined cannot be changed!

Greetings to you, dear guests! You came to our village at a dark hour...

A fierce evil has sprung among us! First, people started disappearing at nights. We found their cold bodies afterwards. There was not a drop of blood left in them!

Then it got worse. A fearsome werewolf appeared in the nearby woods. If someone steps outside of the village walls, consider 'em dead! We wrote to the capital and pleaded for help. They heard us and sent an Inquisitor with an escort. He talked to our sorceress and went to the ruins of the old town. We have not seen them ever since...
From the bottom of our hearts, we thank you! Accept this humble gift as a reward.
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...
You say, those were vampires? Nasty bloodsuckers? How, how did we deserve that punishment!.. Thank you so much! If it were not for you, we'd all be dead.
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...
I see... I told that priest to stay away from the ruins! A great evil must had settled in that town if even the servants of the Light couldn't handle it...
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...

What? A debt? What debt? Never heard of any such!

...

Greedy? Who’s greedy? Me? Oh yeah... hiccup... I are... Here, there you go... hiccup... Take this all, all of if! Blob... Do you wanna drink? Drink some!
I don't take bribes. If you offered to, say, lend me ten Sparks - that's a different matter. I can borrow them from you.
We don't see visitors here often. Especially the living ones... It's a dreadful city...
If there had been any love on earth hitherto, it was not owing to a natural law, but simply because men have believed in immortality.
If we're going to die, then we die! That's our duty! And we, gentlemen, have something else to talk about...

So what are your complaints?

Let me take a look at you.

I need you to take a small quiz in order to evaluate your, ahem, mental state.

So, the first question is: what lies beyond the astralosphere?

h: I was instructed to take what you owe to Ilya Oblomov...

t: And this Mr. Oblomov spent quite a lot here... Agatha prepared dinners for him, didn't she? So he owes us... I counted it myself.
Oh, Mary, where are you, my soul?! We were ruined by the envious villain, we will not find peace in this world or any other...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Please... You and your guild are famous around here, so please help the old man out. We did nothing to deserve this!

A lot of things. The only reason I’m talking to you is that I remember your heroic deeds on Dane. I must say I’m tired of the endless attempts to reconcile us.

Maybe I’m too old for this?..

Apart from a hundred Imperial soldiers around me? Apart from the Great Imperial Mage? Apart from these strange unfamiliar lands? Nothing, absolutely nothing!

I know I shouldn’t be so anxious and trust my men-at-arms... But I just can’t. Maybe I’m too old for this?..

quests: Time to Inform the Proper Parties
To the glory of the valiant defenders of the Fatherland!

t: You're saying Adamant is looking for us? Well, he can wait. See, we are out for a bear hunt, but the bear is way too huge to simply beat him down. We'll have to trick him, you know. See that rabbit over there? We'll feed it poisonous shrooms and dump it off near the bear. He'll eat the rabbit and get poisoned, then we'll go and grab him with our bare hands! How do you like the plan? The only weak spot is that we cannot find any mushrooms...
I'm... Rrrr... admiring the view... It's peaceful here.
Do... Rrr... what you must. I'm not a sorcerer and I can't lie. I do what my heart says, even though... Rrr... it's the heart of an animal.
h: Edward, a vampire from Amarantha, thinks you bewitched and enticed his beloved away. He asked me to kill you.
Too much is at stake to consider their lives. Defend yourself!

t: So, are we gonna beat them?!

h: Ask not to walk on the edge of the path

t: The Well of Souls is our greatest sanctuary. I can show you the way to it.

A mere thought of these filthy creatures swarming our sanctuary makes me shiver with fury! Too bad I've never held a sword in my hands.

I will show you the way to the Well, but then - you're on your own.

h: Teleport to the Well of Souls

t:
Something is wrong with this place. I can sense... Chaos. a Shard of the Great Darkness.

The tissue of reality is very narrow in this place. I think you can enter the Purgatory... if you cross the bridge.

If you change your mind, I can take you anywhere you want.

False light showed itself! It could do nothing against the darkness that took hold of our world! Because the truth is in the old gods, the gods that our people used to worship! Even demons are more powerful than false light! Don't you see it? Throw away the foolish belief in a dead mage and accept the true gods!
Accept the true gods! The gods that were with the tribes of Aro in the days of their youth! Gods that lived in forests and swamps!
Demon skin is resistant to most blades. Do you want me to teach you how to forge the sharpest blades ever?
What designs would you like to buy?

Weaponsmiths are always in demand: we make swords and spiked clubs, bows and crossbows, and even magic wands. But before you get down to crafting weapons, you'll have to practice making kitchen knives and simple hammers.
Now, about the process itself. Use weaponsmith's tools, learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the correct components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. Parts will be harder to obtain. Rods, tips, bases, blades, braidings, additives, flux, granulations, enamels... All of that can be obtained by fighting enemies or bought from other heroes.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The maximum available level of weaponsmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
By the way, if you ever need lower-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Here, take it! They are in rich supply. Feel free to ask me if you need more!
I feel so bad... So weak...
Tekyans are pleased with the victory and thank the player.

Old family trees from the times of Kania before the Cataclysm?.. I'm afraid they're not so easy to read now - the noblemen of old were so fond of constructed Elven languages... and there was over a hundred of those, I think. Only a true expert would be able to deal with this! Though I think I know one, which is fortunate: Alexander Chatsky, the man well versed in these matters of wisdom...

Dear guests, how nice it is to see you at our residence today. I, Julia Lemkova, welcome each of you. For a long time I hid my true abilities and freedom-loving views so as not to challenge any social stereotypes. But it's time for a change, so I decided to take responsibility for this city.

My husband, the governor of this place, turned out to be incapable of making decisions. So I had to step up and act independently. My views have taught me to strive for equality and justice, and I cannot remain indifferent to the problems of our city. As the governor's wife, I'm often forced to take on more responsibility than I would like.

But I do not complain about my lot. On the contrary, I believe that this gives me the opportunity to contribute to the governance of our city. My freedom-loving views sometimes cause confusion among people, but I believe that only freedom and tolerance can lead to true prosperity in our society.
See the arena? The strongest warriors of Sarnaut come here to measure themselves against each other. Soon I'll be an absolute champion in that. Hey, let's train together?

During the biological experiments, I was creating the hybrid flesh of the cyborg's plating and the skull of an ancient Hickutean necromancer.

The result was astounding: the object thus received has learned to sing arias of the suffering of the legs encased in glass boots. Unfortunately, after one performance, it started demanding not just applause, but also gold as royalties. Otherwise it would descend into depression and start wrecking it mechanical limbs.
So glad to see you, colleague! My work is studying the effects of combining necromancy and the newest cybernetics...

h: What new have you learned this week?

t: Good afternoon, colleague! I'm studying the interactions of cyborgs and necrobeasts here...

Our bosses decided that our previous work was worthless! Remember how we used to study genetic mutations? Now, we're told to count the numbers of cells in samples. Who would have thought that we would be dubbed "A dome of complete nutjobs that do nothing at all" for daring to dream of something better?!

Here's my report...
h: What have you managed to learn this week?

t:
Thank you for rescuing me! Now you are able to speak to the Spirits, both good and evil ones. This should help you solve the main task here, to lift the curse!
I'm exhausted now. Hope to see you again. Hope you can get me back my name...
May luck be on your side, friend.

I can supply you with anything you might need to support your Order. The more you contribute to the common cause, the better goods are available for you.

Everything is free but limited in quantity. Make your choice wisely.
According to all these mages, absorbing the power of the Thunderstorm made me some kind of unique creature that can take the form of the Thunderstorm spirit at will...

Greetings! Even though I recovered my destiny, I nevertheless retained my magical power. I continued to serve Empress Hirkalla. According to all these mages, absorbing the power of the Thunderstorm made me some kind of unique creature that can take the form of the Thunderstorm spirit at will... Such power must serve ordinary people... Moreover, together with my husband and former lover I organized a trading enterprise that supplies food and artisan goods to all corners of our allod!

Now, when a new threat has come from the south, I will protect Kelinovka from any danger!

Well? Are you ready to listen?

Hmm…

quests: To Beat or Not to Beat?
Meet with the Keeper of Secrets

t: It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
Our House has a lot of enemies, and I'm protecting my masters from everyone who might want to harm them! There is no higher honor for a Harpy than to fall in battle, protecting the House de Vevre!
I'm Kelena, the commander of Harpies protecting the House de Vevre against external threats! I'm the first sword master of my tribe, a veteran of multiple battles against our enemies!
Is it possible to love everyone, all people, all your neighbors? Of course not. It's even unnatural. In abstract love for humanity, you almost always love only yourself.

The parrot's eyes are filled with delight. He eagerly grabs the glass with his clumsy wings. Mission accomplished!

Now you need to return the fidget to the nest.

I can hardly recognize your friend! Where did he get this hat and glasses?

The young parrot looks pleased with itself, looking at you expectantly.

You need to feed it!

The fledgling ignores the fruit and finishes the cocktail.

You'll have to compromise.

…

The parrot clearly does not want to move from the spot.

…

The parrot shows a little interest, but he is still reluctant.
h: Come on, it will be fun!

t:
I can hardly recognize your friend! Where did he get this hat and glasses?

The young parrot looks pleased with itself.

Have they told you about our new entertainment? It's such a simple idea, but everyone liked it!

You can find colorful pebbles all over the atoll. It's easier to find on the shore in the bay or on the smaller islands in the sea. There's plenty on the seabed, too You can find different-colored pebbles in different parts of the atoll.

To build a tower, you need ten pebbles. Select a spot for the tower, lay a cornerstone, then the rest, one by one. It's easy!

Once you're done, climb it and sit at the top for a while, listening to the cries of seagulls and the crashing of waves... Nothing clears the mind like a peaceful contemplation of the beauty around us.

Now, I've been standing here for days, and you know what? Try it, and you'll see!
The main thing is a good balance and talent for creativity.

If you like building pebble towers, then I have... Puzzles for you! A new one every day! How to solve them?

First, listen to the puzzle and imagine what the tower should look like.

If it's a tower that looks like a tiger, it will be black and orange striped. Take black and orange pebbles and stack them accordingly. Done!

Once you build the tower, I will put a tag on it with a hint: how many colors were guessed and how many pebbles were correctly placed. If you don't guess it right away, the hint will help you make another attempt.

And you can consult with other vacationers! I don't mind!
Kesha is gazing at you with adoration, shuffling his feet impatiently.
Physically the Pridens are inferior to the Orcs. But their hearing...! Your friends were screaming so loudly that I could hear every word in the back of the cave...

For the same reason you are. I'm looking for answers. I remember Captain Koll. The Gibberling lied to me and my people. He betrayed me. But I heard that his blood can set me free... The abducted Spinner, one of the hermits, told me that before her death. According to what your friends are saying, Koll's blood is right in my hands...

quests: In the Claws of the Enemy

t: Ay-hya! I thought I was already dead! But the spirits heard my prayers and sent you to the rescue, eysh!

Morrrons! They call this Orrder, but they are into horrible things, eysh! Even hunhurrs would be appalled by what so-called Initiates and their crazy Prophet are doing. They speak about some Ascension which will allow us to get rid of our outward flesh, which is contaminated by chaos. Damned fanatics cut people into pieces and glue them to parts of stone hunhurrs and bring them to life with wicked prrrayers of their psychotic Prophet, but they only crrreate monsters which are just as twisted as they are, eysh!

They saved me for the last. They thought that my magical skills and the energy of this ancient altar would help them somehow. Then they captured that powerful sorceress and decided to test their conjectures on me. If it were not for you... I don't want to think of it, eysh!

Are you ready for the Season of Blood, kylys? Fine combats, eternal glory, and shiny rewards are waiting!

To gain access to the tournament, visit Allods Online website. Once you’re in, you can start earning Symbols of Blood in combats and exchanging them for valuable prizes!

Gather your friends and join the Circle of Equals with your party! Here nothing matters but your dexterity, wit, and teamwork skills. The prize for the champions is positively enormous!

First, you need to gain access to the Season of Blood. As I already said, you can do that through Allods Online website.

Having purchased access, you can start completing special quests. Those will be rewarded with the Symbols, kylys. You can also buy some on the website, together with the access.
h: How do I earn Symbols of Blood?

t: You want to know what we have in the cargo hold, don't you? Here's the first rule... oh, wait, you should have heard this joke. So, you want to stretch your muscles and crush a few skulls?
h: Ask to go to Cargo Hold

t: Don't go yet. Get drunk first. You don't fight on the arena sober.
h: There's an arena on the ship? That's where I'm heading to.

t: And don't let me see you sober!
h: All right, fine, I'm getting drunk...

quests: A little more bite and a little less bark!

t: Hello there! How can I help you?
What? Casino? Interesting... Perhaps I should visit it. Pull a prank on someone... I love pranks and mischief!
I love locking a new acquaintance in a room with a bear and watching their reaction!

quests: Pledge of Punishment: Gipat Cave Demons
Pledge of Punishment: Gipat Cave Demons

t:
Well, I have some thoughts... But that’s pretty much it. I should travel a bit, to clear my mind.

The Order? Oh, right, the Order. Nefer Ur will take care of it. Our views concur in many respects.
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s an impressive device.
That thing you discussed with Nefer Ur - it got me thinking...

The demons that corrupt the Spark itself with darkness?

They are deadly to any army that has Sparks.

Yes, apparently it does not affect the Arisen... But Nefer Ur will never let us gather an entire army of the Arisen. There aren't enough of them!

But I thought about creatures that don't have a Spark at all. The undead. Thoughtless, wordless undead.

At some point in time, some mages put together an army of the dead. What if we do the same? We'll use evil against evil, darkness against darkness!

But to do that, I'll need help. Yours included.
h: What do you want to do?

t:
I could never think Catherina will turn out to be so double faced! Now it’s time to pay for my own blindness. I an the only one who can drive Dawn through all anomalies and catch upon Eclipse!

She cannot escape. Eclipse is a powerful ship, but Dawn moves faster! We must get her before she goes deep into the Astral!

Now that is a good question. I am not sure that I know the truth, but I think someone really powerful helped her in that. Even a Great Mage has very little to set against a dragon.

I don't believe Catherina could become a traitor. She might behave like a teenager sometimes, but she's really smart. I have no idea what she might need the dragons for. My intuition tells me this all is going to be very, very bad...
h: How did Catherina succeed in imprisoning the Dragons?

t:
I guess we're at the point of no return. Now it's all or nothing. We need to find out, what she's plotting. This all feels so wrong, I don't know what to do. Do you understand me?.. Don't let anything happen to you...

Prepare for the most unexpected things.
Whew, we could hardly beat them. Now that we've defeated the captain, there's very little left to... hey, what's the noise? Look out!
That was pretty hard. I hope we can make up with Catherina in time!

So Catherina tricked two dragons into slavery! I heard rumors about that, but didn't quite believe them. Who could have known, that they would turn out to be true!

There is no time to find out how she managed to do that. Our enemy has got a powerful weapon in the hands. The world is in great danger.

Hold on to your arms, the battle will be hot...

h: Keep the chase in the Astral

t:
"Eclipse" is the modern ship, built by up-to-date technology and filled with latest magic, not possessed neither by the League, nor by the Empire. It is the greatest ship in the world, able to dwell into the deepest layers, right into the heart of the world!

Only our shipyard could create such a miracle! It has no peers! Just imagine the depths of the Astral we can explore now! I am proud that I took part in building this wonderful ship.
So, another civilization has appeared? Oh, Sarnaut... You look away for a second, and the new aborigines are already rapidly evolving, ha ha.

It’s funny. Those stoneheads are so naive, but they aren’t as stupid as they look. The secret of faith’s power will be public knowledge soon. Every peasant will know about it...

They need to take it under control - preventively. And try to guide this faith to where it’s needed.

They said that? That my love for this wreck of a world was incandescent?

Oh ho ho, what can you do - I’ll have to dress up and go then. Flattery always works on me.
I don’t have time for this. Go up the stairs and look around - I’ll grant you access. Just don’t bring this damn allod down on our heads.
Demonic Spark is a rare and mysterious substance. It's different from Sparks of all living beings created by Sarn. Servant of Nihaz in the Tka-Rik's Cave will trade these sparks for valuable rewards.
Three packs of demons have been defeated. This is a good victory. If you like, you may summon another, stronger pack to try and obtain the Demon Spark.
You may choose to complete the trial. You may also collect more spheres to fight Demon of Greed!
I can grant you a gift that lets you safely collect Orbs of Greed. But you will have to pay 10 gold for each collected orb!
Do you know the feeling of lust for blood? This is a scary thing, but it is so pleasant and fulfilling! Don't suppress it. Fight! Win! Then you might survive...
Go ahead, the enemy is waiting!

Even little children know that there are four basic elements in Nature. Some think that they relate to the primal matter. Others think that... Oh, let's cut the chat. An awful monster will arrive soon. It devours the four elements and finishes the meal with primal matter... and this is not an exaggeration, mind you!

The Great Worm, Elemental Devourer is a dangerous opponent. It's attracted here by the elementals that I accidentally summoned. Luckily, its favorite dish is at the same time its greatest weak point. Together with the elementals, it may swallow the stone, gulp the fire, and when two opposite powers meet, the Devourer becomes weak.

Destroy the Elementals to receive their power for a while. Bear in mind, that Stone and Ice Elementals will leave pools of oil and water behind. You may use the pools: set oil on fire, freeze water, or treat the Devourer with good old Lightning, while it is in a pool. While it's frozen, you may try and throw stones at it, and see what happens.

Try different combinations. I bet you will have fun with this demon! Make it suffer!

Long long time ago, when the grass was green and the skies were blue, it used to rain fire on the heads of the warriors of the Great Astral Campaign. Were it demons who caused trouble, or great mages, carried away with their magic - nobody knows. But the fact is, the warriors had to beware of the burning stones falling from the sky.

I'm telling you this, because a huge demon is going to arrive soon, and the weather forecast is not that good. Klavdia Kalugina is predicting rains of white hot stones and flame.

You might have to go in for running a bit - the demon can teleport.

Now let's see how greedy you are. I'm going to summon a lot of magic spheres. Each sphere will burn you like fire, as you pick it up. You may heal yourself, you may pray to your Patron, whatever. Or you may just pay me, and then no harm will be done!

What will you choose?

You are about to fight a mighty demon, called the Demon of the Void, and its minions. You might not survive through this battle! Make sure to kill the minions first, it will weaken the demon. Their blood has different effects, depending on its color. The blue will heal you, the red and the violet will damage your enemies. Beware of the glowing blood, though! Now I must fall silent. From now on, you're on your own.

Do you like hunting? I bet you do. You should be familiar with the old Gibberling hunting tradition - luring the prey by the smell of hot blood. You know the rest, don't you?

I'll give you a lure that attracts demons. Destroy them, as they approach! The trial counts as soon as you finish three packs.

So, you're fond of winter, eh? I don't care much myself. A decent mage can maintain any temperature he or she finds comfortable, even in the coldest weather. Only if the frost is cast by another mage, we have to really fight for the life.

Can you feel how the air is getting colder? The frost is coming... Not that old Father Winter with his long white beard, but a mighty demon! The cave, however, knows how to protect itself. It will spawn spheres of heat. If you collect them on time, the demon won't have a chance to freeze you to death. If not... oh well...

Beware not to slip and trip! If you break your head this way, your death will be the most stupid in the history of Sarnaut.

So common demons are of no problem to you, eh? How about some invulnerable demons? Do you want some? I'll give you a hint: if you defeat the minions first, the boss will be a piece of cake!

Shall we start?

Slaughter... Just the sound of it makes me shiver. I've seen this, and I didn't like it. Neither will you!

If any blood will be spilt, it will be the blood of demons.

Demons have their Sparks, too. They differ from ours, though. Their Sparks are able to transform, mutate or even divide to create new Sparks. Hard to believe, eh? You'll see that yourself. Each new Spark will soon turn into a new demon, so hurry, if you don't want to fight a whole squad of demons!

Are you tired of fighting demons? The next trial will give you a break - a bit of luck is all you will need.
It's easy. This is the portal that you have to enter. If you are lucky, you have two trials less to complete. If not - well, it's your bad luck. Go ahead! I believe that the luck is on your side!
Good luck! You're going to need it.

They say, a sapper has only one chance for a mistake... You will have to see, if it's true. There's a bomb hidden in the cave, and its timer is already counting down! You have one minute to find and demine it, or else!
h: Trial: In Search of the Hidden

t:
They say, cultists are now using the demons for hunting and carrying heavy loads. You are smarter than that, aren't you? Won't you try and tame the demons?

You will have to lure three demons into their cages. They will eat you if you fail, mind you! Better make it quick, if you don't want to turn into their prey.
You may take a little rest and prepare defensive spells for the next trials. You're lucky, I'm in good mood today.
I hate to wake up so early! Do you? I bet you do. The demon you are about to fight will be irritated because of the early wake-up, too. Try and wake him as gentle as you can.

Have you heard about hydras? You know, when you cut off one head and see two more growing? It's the same here. You destroy a Spark, and it divides into two new ones. Sparks are no hydras, so they have their limit. This means you have a chance to defeat them all!

Do you smoke? Do your knees hurt? Do you have any lung disease? No? This is good, because you will have to run about like a crazy hare!

You need to collect yellow spheres. Sounds easy, eh? I'll let a crowd of hungry animals out then. It'll be fun!

Oh, I nearly forgot. Pick up blue spheres to find spells that will stop the blood-hungry crowd.

So run, hero, run!

Suffering... Do you understand what it means?.. When somebody dies, it feels like you are dying. If somebody's hurt, it hurts you too! Many living things are connected, and so are the demons. You will see it yourself.

Special bonds will bind your enemies and boost them. However, if one of them dies, the other will die too.
You may take a little rest and prepare your weapons for the next trials. You're lucky, I'm in good mood today.

You're not the only one who's scared. Demons are afraid of you, too. You'll see that yourself. I will summon a whole lot of demons, and your task is to throw a stone to beat as many as you can, before they flee. Fifteen will be enough!

Sounds easy, doesn't it? Haha, we'll see!

Hello! Long time no see, eh? Does the helm of the last June fit you alright?

Are you here to pass the trial? Excellent. Remember, you only have three attempts. We are not playing games here! Are you ready?
The more trials you complete, the more enemies you manage to defeat, the higher your chance to receive the main prize!
How is the explosion going on?

quests: Emblem of Greatness: staples for transformation

t: Grimwald is responsible! Koshun sees that Grimwald is responsible! I can do more than dig! I can sell! You want clothes?
h: Kobold on such an important duty?

t: You want clothes? You want animals? Grimwald can sell!
Greetings. What about Alice? Why me?
h: Hi, Kolya. I'd like to talk about Alice.

t:
I'm not her best buddy. I hardly know her at all.

Go talk to Phima. You won't hear a word from me!
h: You're her best buddy, you can help me out.

t:
Are you threatening me? You think I'm going to just spill the beans?

You're wrong. Alice is my friend. I'm not going to tell you anything.

I'm... not... ashamed! I'm helping Alice. Do you want me to speak? No way. I'm not talking, uh-uh.

Alice wanted me to keep it secret. So I'm keeping it.
h: Shame on you, Kolya. How can you hide the truth from your comrades?

t: Ehh... How am I? I'm fine. Everything is... great.
I'm Fomkin. Kolya. Nikolay, I mean. Why do you ask?

Everything is fine. If you see Alice, tell her I did everything she asked. And didn't tell anyone anything! Even Rysina, I mean, Katya, asked me where I was. She kept grilling me... Did you know she's a sleepwalker? That's so funny!
Yes, I'm Kolya, Kolya Fomkin. Did Alice send you? I saw you talking.

Wow! I know this language.

It is an order to Blackmane to sneak with his mercenaries to Kurbatskoe field, there create a stir in our rear and then leave to the other side of the mountains. Signed by Hoof... That traitor!

There is no way we can reach him now - the passages are blocked, and the mines are obstructed... But we will get him later anyway!
That portal over there is the headquarters. We recollected all our forces. Now, are you ready to fight?
Thanks for your aid! We've been calling in for reinforcements, but if it weren't for you, they would have found our bare bones on arrival!

This stronghold traces its history back into the centuries. It all started with the cordon lines built here by the Kanians to protect against orcish raids long time ago. It has seen many sieges, happened to burn to the ground, but was rebuilt every time...
When the World broke into pieces, a part of the stronghold disappeared in the Astral, but a bit of it remained - nobody knows what's keeping it.
We discovered and restored it, so it has become one of our strongest keeps. Demons didn't even dare to approach! But a while ago they managed to plant a spy inside these walls to open the gates to the foe... If it weren't for your aid, the Okhotsk Keep would have fallen long ago!

Ahaha! How are you, ? You are here, too!

They told me all the booze is in your honor? Wow! They weren't lying, then? Congratulations.

Ahaha! How are you, ? You are here, too!

It's a miracle I've made it here at all. I had to gave up some of my associates to persuade Zarida to take me along!

There are still a lot of us left on Umoir. Victoria keeps trying to catch some of those animals. But I have all my caches marked on the map - all the landing spots for our smuggled goods.

So I'm quite an important person now - they might even make me a Customs officer.

They told me all the booze is in your honor? Wow! They weren't lying, then? Congratulations.

Hello, hello, ! How are you?

I'm great. I gathered my team again, and now we work for Zarida, transporting all sort of goods through the Astral – from Umoir to Suslanger, from Suslanger to Yakhch, from Yakhch to Umoir.

While the profits are not impressive, we are doing alright, yeah. Stability is more important. And now with this Ambrosia, the money is really good. Except this stupid storm is making things difficult, so right now we're at a standstill.

But there's another thing. We're going to be transporting Mechanoids. Thousands of them have been assembled, all shiny and polished - we just need to load them up and go!

quests: Open Astral Wormhole, catch 5 young demons using the Demonic Eye and…

t: The equipment will be lightweight and comfortable!
